Requested Dean Visser to conduct a home consultation and recommend the best solar solution for the property. With his technical background, he provided a forthright response to all queries and later answered all adjustments to specifications promptly via email. Price was comparative to competitors and purely based on his persona, knowledge, technical support, in-house installers, went for a 6.6 kW grid connected solar system with 21 x 315W Jinko Cheetah solar panels (JKM315M-60), Fronius Primo Inverter (5.0-1), Fronius Smart Meter (63A-1), solar panel mounting system and DC isolators/associated cabling. The cost was 5480.00. Newly installed solar solution so currently tracking the data (usage/generation). Trust this system will stand the test of time and generate considerable savings. Do yourself a favour and try Always Solar!
